player.design_purpose: move_speed_mps sets the pace of positioning against enemies whose speeds are below. melee_reach_m is how far in front of the player a single-target strike connects.

melee.design_purpose: Slower than the player so kiting works, but relentless; the wind-up is the tell for a dodge.

ranged.design_purpose: Keeps its distance and chips with fire so the player learns fire damage exists before the boss; closing on it is the counter.

fast.design_purpose: Outruns the player; packs punish standing still and reward area strikes. The hastened weakness multiplies this.

boss.design_purpose: The breath telegraph must be long enough to read and dash, but the dash cooldown (2.5 s) exceeds the breath period (2 rounds) so fire is never fully dodgeable: resistance preparation stays mandatory.

skills.design_purpose: Dash grants a short invulnerability window matching the round model's 'dodges this round' rule; its distance and cooldown live in skills.json.

design_purpose: round_seconds is the bridge between the sim's round-based encounter (the balance oracle) and real time: attack_period_rounds, breath periods and skill cooldowns become seconds by multiplying by it. Everything else here is time-and-space feel that the round model cannot express; damage, life and mitigation never live in this file (ADR-0003).
